Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.predicate

Class PredicatePushdownSuggestion

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.optimizer.predicate.PredicatePushdownSuggestion
public final class PredicatePushdownSuggestion extends Object
Immutable suggestion for predicate pushdown optimization. Recommends reordering predicates to apply the most selective filters earliest and push predicates closer to data sources.
Since:
1.0.0
